subject: Human Evolution
title: Refugia and Isolation
description: A short lesson to help you apply Refugia and Isolation.

hook.text: When glaciers advanced, human populations retreated to a few warm pockets. These refugia saved our species.

buildup.text: Southern Europe, the Levant, and parts of Africa stayed habitable when ice smothered everything else.

discovery.text: Isolated in refugia, populations diverged genetically—creating the diversity we see in modern humans.

twist.text: When the ice retreated, these groups expanded and mixed, blending their accumulated differences.

climax.text: Ice ages were genetic bottlenecks and mixing bowls, cycling over and over across millennia.

punchline.text: Ice pushed us apart. Thaws brought us back together.

quiz.question: What role did glacial refugia play in human evolution?
options: They preserved and diversified isolated human populations
